build_mask2former_detector: build a Mask2Former detector with backbone, neck, and panoptic head configs for universal image segmentation
run_mask2former_predict: run Mask2Former predict on batch inputs to get panoptic segmentation and instance predictions
run_mask2former_loss: run Mask2Former loss computation on batch inputs and ground truth data samples
review_mask2former_init: review the Mask2Former __init__ to understand backbone, neck, panoptic head, and fusion head initialization
summarize_mask2former_forward: summarize the Mask2Former _forward method that extracts features and runs panoptic head forward pass
